scope: Post-recovery HalfKP-64 scratch result audit and shortest next training strategy

objective_aligned_confirmation.epoch_2_and_4: independent deterministic runs from accepted generation 2
objective_aligned_confirmation.selection: none; evaluate each fixed last-epoch artifact
objective_aligned_confirmation.failure_action: Stop fixed MMTO-lite without adding epochs or tuning hyperparameters.

answer_to_unexpected_failure.conclusion: Partly justified: no global sign or forward inversion was found, but several independent experimental confounders made the observed failure sequence materially worse and some earlier conclusions invalid.
confirmed_confounders: The old search trainer silently clamped 104 of 129 output weights before learning.

Factor-only training imposed component-wise left-right ties that are stronger than the canonical HalfKP symmetry; this is a capacity concern, but its playing-strength effect has not been isolated by an A/B test.
The WDoor expert objective compared the recorded move with one deterministic quiet alternative rather than the move the engine was likely to choose.
Long-direct training applied global decoupled weight decay to all 6,750,720 direct feature parameters at every family batch.
The scratch validation objective does not reproduce training family normalization or source-mix multipliers.
Forty-game screens were incorrectly treated as capable of resolving a five-point difference.

search_replay_one_percent.interpretation: No detectable difference; the one-win score difference is not evidence that the candidate regressed.

existing_mmto_dataset.split_gate_scope: the union of every root and candidate child network input
existing_mmto_dataset.stored_candidate_position: immediate child after the root move
existing_mmto_dataset.teacher_label: depth-4 search score for that root move

required_search_trainer_hardening: Tie the effective gradients and AdaGrad state of center-king direct mirror rows without tying non-center rows.
Preserve exact byte identity for a zero-gradient batch.
Save the last epoch as a first-class manifest-backed artifact even when the validation composite does not improve.
Bind selected kind, epoch, model SHA, and validation metrics to the same artifact.
Report search-pair accuracy after excluding pairs that structurally conflict with the active game-vs-search objective.
Verify teacher model SHA, HKST output SHA, and train/valid separation over the union of every root and candidate packed network input before training.
required_hardening_before_any_future_scr: Make validation use the same family normalization and source-mix semantics as training.

execution_plan.name: harden_search_trainer_and_pass_correctness_gate
requirements: Use accepted generation 2 as both init and teacher.
Maintain center-king direct mirror symmetry after a nonzero training batch.
Add a manifest-backed save-last artifact with selected kind, epoch, SHA, and matching metrics.
Reject HKST parent/output SHA mismatches and any root-or-candidate packed-network-input split overlap.
Deterministically remove colliding valid records from the existing pilot and record the filtered count and output SHA.
Pass targeted tests, the full library tests, a release build, and the 9,311-record zero-loss identity run.

execution_plan.name: corrected_9k_mmto_lite_control_treatment

dataset.valid_filter_status: completed: removed 31 colliding records; residual all-network-input overlap is zero

execution_plan.failure_action: Stop without tuning or automatically implementing a fallback, record the result, and perform a new strategy review.

execution_plan.name: generate_full_rate_4000_wdoor_mmto_lite_teacher
execution_plan.comparison_to_v2_5_0_training: The 385M dense KPP-derived targets and approximately 2.2M depth-4-search-scored immediate-child comparisons are different information units and must not be compared as equivalent sample counts or wall time.
execution_plan.method_scope: MMTO-lite: the trainer backpropagates the immediate child position, not a principal-variation leaf.

execution_plan.name: train_full_direct_only_mmto_lite
execution_plan.selection_rule: Select epoch 2 only when its active game-vs-search validation objective improves over epoch 1 and every safety gate remains satisfied; otherwise select epoch 1.

execution_plan.name: parent_and_release_baseline_matches

parent_match.interpretation: This is a reproducible parent-improvement gate rather than a short non-regression screen.

execution_plan.forty_game_policy: catastrophic-regression screen only; never resolve a five-point promotion margin

execution_plan.name: promote_and_repeat_one_teacher_generation
execution_plan.promotion_rule: Promote solely on the clear parent-match gate; do not promote on a one-win directional change against v2.5.0.

after_generation_3.v2_5_0_score_at_least_0_45: Proceed to the 300 ms intermediate match without requiring a second generation.
after_generation_3.v2_5_0_score_0_40_to_0_45: Regenerate the teacher from promoted generation 3 and run exactly one more full generation.

stop_after_two_generations_if: Cumulative v2.5.0 score improvement is less than 0.05.
Candidate score against v2.5.0 is below 0.40.
execution_plan.after_generation_4: Proceed to the 300 ms intermediate match only when both second-generation stop conditions are avoided.

failure_policy.action: Stop the plan, record the evidence, and conduct a new strategy review without changing the weight, epoch count, seed, or optimizer.
failure_policy.result: The binary gate triggered, but objective-aligned re-evaluation showed treatment-control loss -0.00160113 and margin +0.2348 cp across 1,169 eligible records. The route is paused for one fixed learning-curve confirmation because treatment remains below the accepted parent.
failure_policy.reason_deferred: It requires generator changes, all-legal child evaluation, and scratch-validation repair, so it is broader than the current single-route plan.
